method: Welded OBJ object solids, manifold3d Boolean union/intersection/difference in millimetres; sampled FK from committed URDF. Contacts below 1e-4 mm3 excluded. No continuous collision guarantee.

refined_validation.scope: Sampled visual solids; explicitly whitelisted unbored pivot/shaft and rubber-seat interfaces remain reported. Legacy collision-proxy overlaps are not treated as newly introduced defects.
